user.title: Connect to your 3ds site
user.description: Paste the two values shown under "➕ Connect a device" on the site's HA Link page.

target.title: What is it attached to?
target.description: The first option is the easiest. Use the one-by-one options for anything it could not find.

where.title: Which one?
where.description: For filament storage, use the same name as the storage location in the maintenance log.

sensors.title: Pick sensors
sensors.description: Pick only what you have. The site decides how values are sent (on change or on an interval). State changes are sent right away. {message}

data.name: Name (empty = the item picked above)
data.ent_temp: Temperature sensor (empty = the temperature sensor of the same device as the humidity sensor)
data.snap_public: Show the picture to other members of the site
data.interval: Regular send interval (min) — empty = site default, cannot be shorter

bulk.title: Connect many sensors at once
bulk.description: Pick several humidity sensors — one storage device is created on the site for each. The temperature sensor of the same device is attached automatically and the device / area name is used (you can rename it on the site). Use Configure later to add or remove sensors. {message}

data.humidity_max: Alert when humidity is above (%) — only for newly created ones

device.title: Pick the Home Assistant device
device.description: Pick the printer or machine and its state, progress, remaining time and camera entities are filled in on the next screen (works with any integration: Bambu Lab, Creality, Anycubic, Moonraker, OctoPrint …). You can review and change them there. Skip to pick everything yourself.

auto.title: ⚡ Find and connect
auto.description:
Items whose names match your printers and filament storage locations on the site are pre-checked. If it looks right, just confirm.

🖨️ Printers get state, progress, remaining time and camera; 🧵 storage gets humidity and temperature. Unchecked humidity sensors can be ticked to create a new storage. Unticking removes that connection. {message}

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the site. Check the address.
error.invalid_code: The link code is not valid. Copy it again from the site.
error.need_entity: Pick at least one of humidity, temperature or state.
error.rejected: The site refused it (see the description above).

abort.already_configured: Already added — use Configure on that entry to pick more sensors.
abort.nothing_found: No matching printers or humidity sensors were found. Add the integration again and use the one-by-one options.
